6 /**
7  * Generates a lightweight, indented .txt tree representation of the codebase,
8  * respecting standard gitignore patterns.
9  *
10  * @param {string} projectDir - The root directory of the project.
11  * @returns {string} - Formatted directory tree text.
12  */
13 export function generateTreeText(projectDir) {
14   if (projectDir === null || projectDir === undefined || typeof projectDir !== 'string') {
15     return '';
16   }
17   const patterns = getGitignorePatterns(projectDir);
18   const lines = [];
19 
20   function traverse(currentDir, depth = 0) {
21     let files;
22     try {
23       files = fs.readdirSync(currentDir);
24     } catch {
25       return; // Skip unreadable directories
26     }
27 
28     // Sort alphabetically for deterministic tree structure
29     files.sort();
30 
31     for (const file of files) {
32       const fullPath = path.join(currentDir, file);
33       const relPath = path.relative(projectDir, fullPath);
34       
35       let stat;
36       try {
37         stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
38       } catch {
39         continue; // Skip if stat fails
40       }
41 
42       const isDir = stat.isDirectory();
43       if (isIgnored(relPath, patterns, isDir)) {
44         continue;
45       }
46 
47       const indent = '  '.repeat(depth);
48       if (isDir) {
49         lines.push(`${indent}${file}/`);
50         traverse(fullPath, depth + 1);
51       } else {
52         lines.push(`${indent}${file}`);
53       }
54     }
55   }
56 
57   traverse(projectDir);
58   return lines.join('\n');
59 }

61 /**
62  * Helper to check if a file path is included in the Scout's list of relative paths.
63  * Supports exact file matches and directory prefix matches.
64  *
65  * @param {string} filePath - The relative path of the file to check.
66  * @param {string[]} includeList - Array of paths/directories to include.
67  * @returns {boolean} - True if the path is semantically included.
68  */
69 export function isPathIncluded(filePath, includeList) {
70   if (!Array.isArray(includeList)) return false;
71   const normalizedFile = filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
72 
73   for (let item of includeList) {
74     if (typeof item !== 'string') continue;
75     const normalizedItem = item.replace(/\\/g, '/');
76 
77     if (normalizedFile === normalizedItem) {
78       return true;
79     }
80 
81     // Directory prefix match (e.g., if "src" is in include list, "src/index.js" matches)
82     const dirPrefix = normalizedItem.endsWith('/') ? normalizedItem : normalizedItem + '/';
83     if (normalizedFile.startsWith(dirPrefix)) {
84       return true;
85     }
86   }
87   return false;
88 }

90 /**
91  * Filters the codebase payload to only include files and directories matching the include list.
92  * Supports both:
93  * - Array of objects: [ { path: 'relative/path', content: '...' }, ... ] (filters by `file.path`)
94  * - Array of strings: [ 'relative/path', ... ] (filters by string value)
95  * - Object dictionary: { 'relative/path': 'content', ... } (filters keys)
96  *
97  * @param {Array|Object} payload - The unfiltered codebase payload.
98  * @param {string[]} includeList - The list of allowed relative paths.
99  * @returns {Array|Object} - The pruned payload.
100  */
101 export function prunePayload(payload, includeList) {
102   if (!includeList || !Array.isArray(includeList)) {
103     return payload;
104   }
105 
106   if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
107     return payload.filter(file => {
108       const filePath = typeof file === 'string' ? file : file.path;
109       return isPathIncluded(filePath, includeList);
110     });
111   } else if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
112     const pruned = {};
113     for (const [filePath, content] of Object.entries(payload)) {
114       if (isPathIncluded(filePath, includeList)) {
115         pruned[filePath] = content;
116       }
117     }
118     return pruned;
119   }
120 
121   return payload;
122 }

124 /**
125  * Calls the Scout model with the tree text and the objective, returning the list of paths to include.
126  *
127  * @param {object} params
128  * @param {string} params.projectDir - Root project directory.
129  * @param {string} params.userObjective - The user's query or objective.
130  * @param {Function} [params.agent] - Optional agent override (useful for mock testing).
131  * @param {object} [params.env] - Process env override.
132  * @param {Function} [params.log] - Log callback.
133  * @returns {Promise<string[]|null>} - List of relative paths to include, or null on failure.
134  */
135 export async function runScoutPass({
136   projectDir,
137   userObjective,
138   agent = null,
139   env = process.env,
140   log = () => {}
141 } = {}) {
142   try {
143     const treeText = generateTreeText(projectDir);
144 
145     let activeAgent = agent;
146     if (!activeAgent) {
147       // W4 (2026-07-05): the scout is a lightweight, high-volume curation pass — it reads a whole tree
148       // to pick relevant paths — so it runs on the STANDARD (current, cheaper, high-context) agy LABEL,
149       // resolved via the TRIO_TIER ladder. NEVER a hardcoded API-style id (the old hardcoded default
150       // was a phantom id that live agy silently degrades to Flash anyway).
151       const model = env.GANDALF_SCOUT_MODEL || env.GEMINI_MODEL
152         || resolveGeminiModel({ env: { ...env, TRIO_TIER: 'standard' } });
153       const seam = makeGeminiCliSeam({ model, env, log });
154       activeAgent = seam.agent;
155     }
156 
157     const prompt = `You are an agentic codebase scout. You are given a directory tree structure of a codebase and the user's objective.
158 Your task is to identify and return a list of files or directories that are semantically relevant to the user's objective and should be included in the context.
159 
160 User Objective:
161 "${userObjective}"
162 
163 Codebase Directory Tree:
164 \`\`\`
165 ${treeText}
166 \`\`\`
167 
168 Respond with a JSON object containing an "include" key with an array of relative paths (files or directories) to include.`;
169 
170     const schema = {
171       type: 'object',
172       properties: {
173         include: {
174           type: 'array',
175           items: { type: 'string' }
176         }
177       },
178       required: ['include']
179     };
180 
181     const result = await activeAgent(prompt, { schema, label: 'scout-pass' });
182     let includeList = null;
183 
184     if (typeof result === 'object' && result !== null) {
185       includeList = result.include;
186     } else if (typeof result === 'string') {
187       const parsed = JSON.parse(result);
188       includeList = parsed.include;
189     }
190 
191     if (Array.isArray(includeList)) {
192       return includeList;
193     }
194     throw new Error('Scout model response did not contain an array under the "include" key.');
195   } catch (err) {
196     log(`Scout pass error: ${err.message}`);
197     return null;
198   }
199 }

201 /**
202  * High-level Scout pre-flight check wrapper.
203  * Initiates the scout call and filters the payload. Gracefully falls back to the full payload on failure.
204  *
205  * @param {object} params
206  * @param {string} params.projectDir - Root project directory.
207  * @param {Array|Object} params.payload - Full payload.
208  * @param {string} params.userObjective - User objective.
209  * @param {Function} [params.agent] - Optional agent override.
210  * @param {object} [params.env] - Process env override.
211  * @param {Function} [params.log] - Log callback.

214 export async function scoutAndFilter({
215   projectDir,
216   payload,
217   userObjective,
218   agent = null,
219   env = process.env,
220   log = () => {}
221 } = {}) {
222   const includeList = await runScoutPass({ projectDir, userObjective, agent, env, log });
